The main takeaway from our work is that
the halo-model analysis of galaxy clustering is a powerful tool to constrain galaxy-halo relations and to provide new insight into the nature of the galaxy-halo connection.

the clustering of photomatically selected galaxies in the SDSS can be explained using the standard model of halo occupation, with the only modification being the addition of a halo segregation parameter that allows early- (late-) type galaxies to be in separate haloes.
